items.title: Debit Card Purchases Grew at Double the Rate of Credit in October, New Velera Data Reveal
items.why: Debit outpacing credit may signal affluent users avoiding revolving debt; watch whether premium card spend keeps pace.
items.summary_ai: Velera data show October debit card purchases grew at roughly twice the pace of credit card purchases.
items.take: Debit outpacing credit may signal affluent users avoiding revolving debt; watch whether premium card spend keeps pace.
data_points: Double the credit growth rate, October
